inference_unit: base instance, 24 existing development instances; seeds are within-instance repeats
primary_comparison: savings_vnd versus parallel_savings, paired per instance after mean over three solver seeds
secondary_comparison: multistart_vnd versus savings_vnd; configurations of the SAME local-search family
freeze_rule: freeze all source, protocol, manifest and input hashes before first batch solver call
stop_rule: all 360 scheduled calls once; preserve every failure; no result-driven tuning or replacement
budgets: same solver CPU ceiling and complete-process wall ceiling for each call; unused budget is not forced to be spent
purpose: development baseline strengthening and measured quality/cost tradeoff; no H1/H2 or final-test claim
